comparison.objective: Uniformly heat-shrink a cable sleeve, not mechanically commission a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Rotates cable while scanning a heat gun and controlling exposure and clearance; no unlocking, tightening, or impact adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: All sleeve stations recovered, adhesive visible, none charred, gun off and stowed versus two non-bottoming carriage cycles.
comparison.reason: Controlled thermal exposure over time is meaningfully different from mechanical calibration.
